summary: Build practical agricultural lending skills in underwriting, cash flow analysis, and portfolio risk control. Enroll in this 5-day course.
lede: Agricultural lending helps credit professionals assess farm and agribusiness applications using production cycles, repayment sources and sector-specific risks. For loan officers, credit analysts and portfolio teams, the work includes projecting seasonal cash flow, evaluating repayment capacity and collateral, structuring loans around farm operations, and monitoring risk through ratings, early-warning indicators and portfolio reports.
audienceIntro: This agricultural lending course is intended for professionals who assess farm credit, manage agricultural portfolios, or support lending decisions in agri-finance settings.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of basic lending concepts, financial statements, and credit administration. Prior exposure to farm operations, agribusiness cash flows, or loan appraisal processes is helpful. No coding is required. Advanced concepts such as agricultural stress testing, risk grading, and portfolio monitoring are taught at an operational level, with practical application in templates and case exercises.
